operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] replicapoolupdater rolling updates list instance updates [PATH] zones rolling updates instance updates [PARAMS] alt fields filter ip key max oauth page pretty print project quota results rolling token update user zone [SCHEMA] instance list update

operations.description: Inserts and starts a new update.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapoolupdater rolling updates insert [PATH] zones rolling updates [PARAMS] alt fields ip key oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA] operation rolling update

operations.description: Cancels an update. The update must be PAUSED before it can be cancelled. This has no effect if the update is already CANCELLED.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapoolupdater rolling updates cancel [PATH] zones rolling updates cancel [PARAMS] alt fields ip key oauth pretty print project quota rolling token update user zone [SCHEMA] operation

operations.description: Pauses the update in state from ROLLING_FORWARD or ROLLING_BACK. Has no effect if invoked when the state of the update is PAUSED.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapoolupdater rolling updates pause [PATH] zones rolling updates pause [PARAMS] alt fields ip key oauth pretty print project quota rolling token update user zone [SCHEMA] operation

operations.description: Continues an update in PAUSED state. Has no effect if invoked when the state of the update is ROLLED_OUT.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapoolupdater rolling updates resume [PATH] zones rolling updates resume [PARAMS] alt fields ip key oauth pretty print project quota rolling token update user zone [SCHEMA] operation

operations.description: Rolls back the update in state from ROLLING_FORWARD or PAUSED. Has no effect if invoked when the state of the update is ROLLED_BACK.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapoolupdater rolling updates rollback [PATH] zones rolling updates rollback [PARAMS] alt fields ip key oauth pretty print project quota rolling token update user zone [SCHEMA] operation
